title: Evaluation of padded clauses
statement: Let $C$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ sign variables, with no variable index repeated and with at most three literals. Extend an assignment to these variables by three additional sign variables, and restrict it back to the original variables. Every clause in the specified padding of $C$ evaluates to $-1$ under the extended assignment if and only if $C$ evaluates to $-1$ under the restricted assignment.
hypotheses_covered: No variable index occurs more than once in the clause
The clause has at most three literals
An assignment to the $n$ original and three additional sign variables
